summary: Live verification overturned two long-standing genius-list blockers: the S82 sync-studio-events deploy has been green in CI since 2026-06-12 (SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN exists as an Actions secret and deploy-supabase-function.yml deploys all five functions), and the Supabase URL-allowlist concern is moot because every edge function ships Access-Control-Allow-Origin:* (live OPTIONS from https://callofdoodie.wtf returns 200). The product lane is a determinism arc: seed the enemy-spawn RNG with per-wave derived streams, ship a REMATCH-at-death-wave drill on top of it, and extend deterministic replay with a derived single-contact-enemy parity slice - plus a hidden balance-lab insight surface, a draw-loop perf pass, and dead-code hygiene.

items.title: REMATCH drill - restart at your death wave with the same seed
items.why: Death is the game's most motivated moment and the debrief already coaches the player, but the only action is a full restart from wave 1. A REMATCH button that relaunches at the death wave with the same seed converts coaching into immediate deliberate practice. Depends on seeded-enemy-rng per-wave streams for honest 'same wave, same enemies' fidelity.
items.recipe: Add optional startWave to initGame(forceSeed, startWave) (App.jsx:544, currentWave hardcoded 1 at :554); scale starting loadout/level context sanely; add REMATCH AT WAVE N button to DeathScreen next-run drill block (DeathScreen.jsx:864-883) calling onStartGame(runSeed, deathWave); track rematch_started local Studio event; exclude rematch runs from leaderboard submission to protect score trust.

L1.recipe: startWave param + REMATCH button, non-deterministic spawns, leaderboard-excluded practice run.

L2.recipe: L1 + per-wave seeded spawn streams from seeded-enemy-rng so the rematch wave replays the same enemy sequence; rematch receipt event.

L3.recipe: L2 + drill framing: show the coach tip that triggered the rematch in-HUD, score the retry against the death wave outcome, and chain best-of-3 mastery receipts.

items.title: Seed enemy spawning with per-wave derived RNG streams
items.why: The run seed only drives arena layout (App.jsx:811-920); enemy type, spawn side, position, elite rolls and timing all use global Math.random (gameHelpers.js:34,54-59,83-101; App.jsx:1299-1300,2314). So REPLAY #seed and Daily Challenge reproduce the map but not the fight - a quiet fairness gap for a game whose leaderboard sells seeded competition. Deriving an independent LCG stream per wave as hash(seed,wave) makes any wave reproducible without simulating prior waves.
items.recipe: Add createWaveRng(seed, wave) (mulberry32/LCG over a mixed hash) in src/gameHelpers.js; thread an rng param through spawnEnemy() and the App.jsx spawn call sites for type roll, side/position, elite/berserker rolls, shootTimer, wobble and spawn jitter; keep all other combat randomness on Math.random; cover determinism with unit tests (same seed+wave = identical spawn sequence; different wave = different).

L1.recipe: Seed only enemy type + spawn side/position via injected rng; jitter and elite rolls stay global.

L2.recipe: Full per-wave streams: type, side/position, elite rolls, shootTimer, wobble, spawn jitter, boss-adjacent rolls, with determinism tests.

L3.recipe: L2 + seeded streams for crit/spread/pickup rolls and trace-recorded stream checkpoints feeding true replay parity.

items.title: Deterministic replay slice: one derived contact enemy vs stored trace movement
items.why: Phase 2B's honest next slice per S106 canon: stored traces carry player commands only, so a true enemy replay is impossible today - but a seed-derived single contact enemy stepped with the real chase math (direct-vector fallback + wobble, App.jsx:3331-3365) against the reconstructed player path is fully deterministic with current trace data. It extends replay evidence without touching the advisory gate label.
items.recipe: Add runDeterministicContactEnemySlice() to src/utils/replayResim.js with coverage label trace_movement_one_contact_enemy_derived: derive spawn side/position/frame from seed via local LCG, step the enemy with atan2 chase + wobble jitter and speed from ENEMY_TYPES[0] wave-1 scaling, detect contact at size/2+15 with 30-frame invincibility receipts; expose via runResim() alongside deterministicCombatSlice; add fixtures to replayTraceFixtures.js and extend validate-replay-state-stepper-fixtures.mjs; keep runResim gate heuristic_pressure_estimate/advisory per DECISIONS 2026-07-01.

L1.recipe: Slice with fixed spawn (derived once from seed), contact receipts, unit tests only.

L2.recipe: L1 + fixture-gated validation in the state-stepper script and runResim() wiring with the new coverage label.

L3.recipe: L2 + multi-enemy derived scenario and flow-field-aware stepping once obstacle layout is reproduced from the arena seed.

items.title: Surface the balance-lab insight to players (currently debug-gated)
items.why: HomeV2 computes a balance-lab insight from local telemetry (HomeV2.jsx:213) but renders it only behind the ?debug=ops gate (:123-127, :850-873), so a real intelligence surface is invisible to every player. Promoting the single topInsight line into the visible intel area closes the loop between local telemetry and player-facing coaching.
items.recipe: Render balanceLab.topInsight as one compact chip/line in the visible HomeV2 intel area when present, keep the full lab table debug-gated, cover with a HomeV2 test asserting the insight renders without the debug flag.

L1.recipe: Un-gate topInsight as a single line in the intel ticker area.

L2.recipe: L1 + dismiss persistence and a test for render + absence when no insight.

L3.recipe: L2 + rotate insights by recency and link each insight to its action (loadout, drill, route).

items.title: Close two stale credential-gated genius items with live evidence
items.why: The top two genius-list blockers are stale: deploy-supabase-function.yml has SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN + SUPABASE_PROJECT_REF as Actions secrets and has deployed sync-studio-events successfully five times since 2026-06-12 (last 2026-06-18, run 27794392576); and every edge function ships Access-Control-Allow-Origin:* with a live 200 OPTIONS from https://callofdoodie.wtf, so no Supabase-side allowlist blocks the new domain. Observability must not lie - the board should say so.
items.recipe: Mark the S82 sync-studio-events TASK_BOARD item done with the CI-run evidence; narrow the S61 allowlist items to the genuinely-gated PostHog/Sentry/Ko-fi dashboard halves (analytics capability still MISSING); trigger one fresh workflow_dispatch of deploy-supabase-function.yml to confirm current-tree deployability; regenerate the innovation pack.

L2.recipe: L1 + fresh workflow_dispatch deploy verification + innovation pack regen.

L3.recipe: L2 + a scripts/verify-edge-deploy.mjs freshness check comparing last deploy run date to last supabase/functions commit.

items.title: Remove per-frame allocations in drawGame hot loop
items.why: drawGame allocates a filtered copy of the enemies array twice every frame (drawGame.js:467,1123), rebuilds full-screen gradients every frame (:150,351,1148,1168,1397), and allocates per-enemy body-shape array literals per frame (:576-651). At 60fps with dozens of enemies this is steady GC pressure on the game's hottest path; the vignette cache pattern from S96 (_runActVignetteStyle) already proves the fix shape.
items.recipe: Replace the two filter(Boolean).forEach passes with plain for-loops that skip falsy entries; add a size-keyed gradient cache (key W:H) for the static full-screen gradients following the S96 vignette-cache pattern; hoist the body-shape coordinate tables to module-level constants; verify no visual change via existing tests + build.

L1.recipe: Kill the two filter(Boolean) allocations only.

L2.recipe: L1 + gradient cache + hoisted shape tables.

L3.recipe: L2 + a dev-only per-frame allocation counter wired into the existing frame-budget monitor.

items.title: Delete four dead non-spatial sound exports
items.why: soundHit, soundPickup, soundGrenade and soundEnemyDeath were superseded by spatial ...At variants and have zero non-test callers (~55 dead lines). Dead exports mislead future sessions into wiring the wrong variant.
items.recipe: Delete the four exports from src/sounds.js after re-verifying zero callers; run lint + full suite.

L2.recipe: L1 + grep sweep for other superseded non-spatial variants.

L3.recipe: L2 + a lint-time dead-export check for src/sounds.js.
